deps.edn.reason: The git floors and pins on repositories that are bundled here become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (dep org.clojure/clojure, dep org.clojure/clojurescript, alias :test reduced to :extra-paths, alias :lint): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the paths.

src/kotoba/sqlite/varint.kotoba.reason: Canonical Kotoba-only SQLite v3 varint codec; introduced for the native selfhost engine under JUN-768.

src/kotoba/sqlite/header.kotoba.reason: Added validated SQLite in-memory database page-count replacement for bounded image builders; caller still owns counter advancement and atomic persistence under JUN-768.

src/kotoba/sqlite/notepad_record.kotoba.reason: Canonical Kotoba-only four-TEXT SQLite record codec for Itonami cron_notepad; introduced under JUN-768.

src/kotoba/sqlite/page.kotoba.reason: Added SQLite table-leaf local-payload calculation, overflow-cell encoding, overflow-page chain encoding, and bounded table-leaf append with an explicit overflow-page pointer for JUN-768.

src/kotoba/sqlite/record.kotoba.reason: Canonical Kotoba-only bounded SQLite v3 record layout decoder for schema discovery; introduced under JUN-768.

src/kotoba/sqlite/schema.kotoba.reason: Canonical Kotoba sqlite_schema table and primary-key autoindex record encoders for JUN-768.

src/kotoba/sqlite/database.kotoba.reason: Added bounded Amu selfhost SQLite image replacement under a persistent writer lock: fail-closed FS35 EXISTS checks for WAL/SHM/rollback-journal sidecars, FS2 N randomized staging, FS2 B, file fsync, atomic rename, parent-directory fsync, and explicit statuses under JUN-768. Standard SQLite byte-range lock coordination and random crash-left-stage collection remain open; evidence is in the native receipt.

src/kotoba/sqlite/reader.kotoba.reason: Canonical Kotoba-only SQLite schema/table B-tree reader with bounded overflow materialization, validated job/key lookup, and KNV1 direct value result under JUN-768.

test/native/first-row-writer.kotoba.reason: Updated the native writer fixture to require acceptance of an earlier unique composite key while retaining duplicate refusal controls under JUN-768.

test/native/unordered-insert.kotoba.reason: Source-pinned Amu native fixture for arbitrary-order unique composite-key insertion, index ordering, duplicate refusal, key deletion after reordering, lookup, and FS2 persistence under JUN-768.

test/native/header-page-count.kotoba.reason: Added source-pinned Amu-native positive and negative control for page-count replacement and change-counter synchronization under JUN-768.

test/native/overflow-first-row-writer.ko.reason: Added source-pinned Amu-native 16-KiB first-row overflow writer fixture with duplicate refusal, Kotoba readback, header page-count check and scoped FS2 export under JUN-768.

test/native/overflow-mutation.kotoba.reason: Added KSL2-pinned Amu-native fixture for a 16-KiB overflow insert, append, overflow-row update, exact-key delete, Kotoba positive/refusal reads, and FD3-scoped FS2 export under JUN-768.

test/native/notepad-upsert-contract.koto.reason: Source-pinned Amu-native positive/refusal fixture for bounded SQLite upsert/publish, randomized-stage collision avoidance, independent sidecar refusals preserving existing database bytes, and read-only SQLite oracle readback under JUN-768.
